title: Two-controller co-op with a PS5 (player 1, Arisen) and an Xbox (player 2, pawn)
intro: Needs: DPC 0.9.170-dev13b, co-op OFF, playing the Arisen, your main pawn close by (this test brings it next to you if it is far), somewhere open with no enemies. Player 1 = wired PS5, player 2 = Xbox. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

steps.text: Get ready: both controllers in hand. Press End to start.
PLAYER 1 (PS5): walk a step. Then PLAYER 2 (Xbox): hold L3 + R3 (both stick clicks) until it says player 2 joined. (Holding L3 + R3 also moves this guide on; that's fine, keep holding.)
Both walk on your own stick: Arisen on the PS5, pawn on the Xbox. Each stick moves only its own character?
Both: attack, jump, sprint. Each controller only works its own character?
Cameras: player 1 turns the camera on the PS5 right stick while player 2 moves the Xbox right stick. Camera follows player 1 only?
PLAYER 2 (Xbox): cycle to another pawn (your usual switch combination). Does player 2 move the new pawn?
PLAYER 1 (PS5): hold L3 + R3 for 3 seconds until co-op ends.
PS5 walk, then Xbox walk: both drive the Arisen again (the one you use)?
Done. Tell Claude which steps worked and anything odd.

probes.pads:
local o = {}
local function ax(v) if not v then return "-" end local ok, s = pcall(function() return string.format("%.2f,%.2f", v.x, v.y) end) return ok and s or "?" end
pcall(function()
  local inp = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CharacterManager"):call("get_ManualPlayer"):call("get_Input")
  o[#o + 1] = string.format("arisenL=%s arisenB=%X", ax(inp:call("get_AxisL")), inp:get_field("ButtonOnFlags") or 0)
end)
pcall(function()
  local d = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.UserPadManager"):call("get_ActiveUserPad"):call("getDevice")
  o[#o + 1] = string.format("active=%X", d:get_address() & 0xFFFFFF)
end)
local R = _G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R
if R then
  local t = R.tp
  o[#o + 1] = string.format("coop=%s p1=%X p2=%X wait=%s switches=%d err=%s", tostring(R.api_table.state().coop.active), (t.p1 or 0) & 0xFFFFFF, (t.p2 or 0) & 0xFFFFFF, tostring(t.wait_release), t.pa_n or 0, tostring(t.err or t.pa_err))
  for _, d in ipairs(R.tp_devs()) do
    local v = R.tp_read(d)
    o[#o + 1] = string.format("[%X b=%X L=%.2f,%.2f]", d:get_address() & 0xFFFFFF, v.b, v.lx, v.ly)
  end
end
return table.concat(o, " ")
